item.title: Luddesdon Road is currently unsafe to drive on. The road surface is uneven, not level, and has multiple cracks and defects that pose a hazard to vehicles., 6th September
item.description:
The condition of Luddesdon Road has deteriorated to the point where it is causing damage to vehicles. The uneven surface and extensive cracking have already damaged the front lip of my car, and the poor road quality is also putting tyres at risk. This is not just an inconvenience but a genuine safety concern for all drivers using the road. The road urgently needs a full resurfacing, as patch repairs would not be sufficient given the extent of the damage. Please can this be investigated and addressed as soon as possible to prevent further vehicle damage and ensure the road is safe for public use.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Luddesdon Road, Upper Belvedere, Greater London
